entries.text: I need prayers but not for me. But for the people that are in the path of tonight’s severe storm that I will be chasing here in North Dakota as a storm chaser you see a lot of pain, suffering and heartbreak whether it’s losing peoples homes or lives my area has a 10% tornado chance and I just wanna help pray for the people that could potentially get hurt in this storm.

Isaac we will pray brother, please be sure if you can figure out how we can support with getting bibles into the hands of these folks and connecting them with local churches that is one body of Jesus Christ!

Prayer Request 6/9/2026:

About to be meeting with Gideon's International to lay the ground work for an official sponsorship or collaboration with our ministry.

Please pray so the meeting goes well and God provides us with the correct people for His work to be done!
Pray for the team today as they’re doing their mini evangelism at Jennings Memorial ! May God touch hearts!

Thanksgiving Announcement 6/11/2026:

So far we have away 3 Bibles, prayed for Marcus and testified, encouraging him to follow Jesus!

Pray for us please Seed the Word members and may Jesus make Himself known to all!

Hey guys, pray for me, for discernment over a relationship.

Pray for Brandon and Jeremiah. Just as we all need to be closer to Jesus, they need Jesus too. May they open that door that God is knocking at, for the door knob is only on one side, and that is the side we’re standing on.

I know it's late but officially what I can account for is 162 Bibles for our ongoing outreaches.

That's 162 Bibles not including additional distributions made by our partners with Seed the Word.

The vision for Washington to become a center for worship and forerunner for evangelism is happening in Jesus' name!

I need prayers guys

1. Commencement walk at 3pm. That God gives me the confidence, and decernment to walk up on stage in front of a crowd, and take my diploma. That I can grasp it, and actually "graduate"

2. I've been struggling alot, I need a routine, something to work for. I don't want to be like David when he was off the field of battle. 

3. Help my request for time off on Aug 13 - 16 to go through with my Job so I can attend SOL YA camp. 

4. Overall prayers are always welcome, and definitely needed.

I did evangelism in Lake Stevens yesterday, but I specifically want to pray for our sister in faith Gia, she had met be over 2 years ago, and I have seen her every summer at the water. She saw me when I was at my worst, (emo picture) to when I started following God fully, to then when I met her once again to evangelize to her. She has pulled away and has fallen for the cares of the world, but she recieved his word joyfully, and she has seen his work in me, she knows he's true, and right, and good. Pray that she may open her Bible and walk with him again, she's been supportive of my journey since the very beginning, I want to support hers. 

I want to pray for the other brothers and sisters I encountered some mocked others rejoiced, pray that they may come to Christ and that they may open their dusty Bibles, I want to pray for those who claim the title of Christian but choose not to walk the path, pray for reconciliation, and intercession, lest they be spit out by our Lord. 

I pray for each of the members of this ministry, that they may serve faithfully and be filled with the spirit and boldness, that they can let go of hurts of the soul, and cast their anxieties to the Lord, for he cares for each and every single one of us. I pray each and every one of you walk close to him, and hold fast to him, that your feet may never stumble and your paths may be made peaceful. Remember the flowers, how the petals adorn the grass, how the birds get the food they need, the Lord provides, how much more do you think our Dad in heaven will give us.

I pray for David's upcoming baptism that he can walk with confidence, and courage and wisdom. That he may die in a likewise manner in Christ and be born again with him. That he may be made new and whole, and the spirit may fill him, and he may lead this ministry full of you Lord

I pray for any other members needs, and also just our families amd friends connected to us. I pray for my Aunt who passed away, I pray she is with you, that she accepted you that she has entered your rest Lord. Forgive her of her sins, and remember her in your kingdom.

Forgive us for our inequities, and transgressions, and hold us in our hurts. We are like little children throwing temper tantrums, so please be patient with us in our times of hurt, even when we cry out violence or wish for death, please cover us with love and grace.

Lead us away from all temptations and guard us from the enemy, which has come to kill, steal, and destroy us. Armor us and let us crush his skull beneath our feet for we tread on the serpent in your mighty name. 

In Jesus name I pray,

Amen
